problem_text:
A regional sales representative must conduct a series of essential client visits across eight distinct corporate offices.

The travel times between offices are recorded in minutes:
* Office Alpha to Office Beta: 30.9 minutes
* Office Alpha to Office Gamma: 133.0 minutes
* Office Alpha to Office Delta: 192.8 minutes
* Office Alpha to Office Epsilon: 186.7 minutes
* Office Alpha to Office Zeta: 207.5 minutes
* Office Alpha to Office Theta: 66.6 minutes
* Office Alpha to Office Iota: 150.4 minutes
* Office Beta to Office Gamma: 111.0 minutes
* Office Beta to Office Delta: 201.5 minutes
* Office Beta to Office Epsilon: 179.8 minutes
* Office Beta to Office Zeta: 208.7 minutes
* Office Beta to Office Theta: 62.4 minutes
* Office Beta to Office Iota: 146.2 minutes
* Office Gamma to Office Delta: 176.3 minutes
* Office Gamma to Office Epsilon: 103.5 minutes
* Office Gamma to Office Zeta: 154.5 minutes
* Office Gamma to Office Theta: 81.3 minutes
* Office Gamma to Office Iota: 90.5 minutes
* Office Delta to Office Epsilon: 97.7 minutes
* Office Delta to Office Zeta: 51.9 minutes
* Office Delta to Office Theta: 142.0 minutes
* Office Delta to Office Iota: 87.0 minutes
* Office Epsilon to Office Zeta: 57.0 minutes
* Office Epsilon to Office Theta: 120.3 minutes
* Office Epsilon to Office Iota: 38.1 minutes
* Office Zeta to Office Theta: 146.2 minutes
* Office Zeta to Office Iota: 67.2 minutes
* Office Theta to Office Iota: 84.9 minutes

The objective is to determine the most time-efficient itinerary that allows the representative to visit every corporate office precisely one time, concluding the circuit by returning to the initial office of departure.
